failedTrial.qualification: invalidViewport occurs before scene construction/submission. Prior trace omitted actual dimensions/scale, so zero vs nonfinite/oversized/invalid-scale cannot be identified. This is not evidence of a RealityRenderer failure.

requested.requestedViewport: two scalar-description Strings width,height; preserves nonfinite without JSON failure

schemaDelta.waiting-for-viewport: same session/revision after requested; zero width or height, finite nonnegative dimensions and positive finite scale within existing 4096-pixel bound; no scene ctor/submission

behavior: Consumes zero request and waits solely for existing normal onChange/onAppear; no timer, layout mutation, forced render or retry loop. Nonfinite, nonpositive scale, negative or oversized input fails explicitly. Later ordinary input creates new revision through unchanged path.
helperAdaptation: Allow waiting-for-viewport after its requested row, before any submitted row for that revision; require logged actual input has a zero dimension and no scene ctor/submission for that request. Still require current successful publication within unchanged external bound.
